description: This file defines models, query parameters, and a fetcher class for handling Fama-French breakpoints data, including various types of financial ratios and percentiles, with methods for data extraction and transformation.

classes.name: FamaFrenchBreakpointQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching Fama-French breakpoints, including breakpoint type and date range.

classes.name: FamaFrenchBreakpointData
classes.description: Represents a single set of Fama-French breakpoint data, including percentiles and metadata.

classes.name: FamaFrenchBreakpointFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming Fama-French breakpoints data, including data extraction from external sources.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a FamaFrenchBreakpointQueryParams object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts breakpoint data from the Fama-French FTP using helper functions.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into structured FamaFrenchBreakpointData objects, applying date filters if specified.
